Asteroids Hyper 64.name: Asteroids Hyper 64
Asteroids Hyper 64.summary: Asteroids Hyper 64 is an updated version of the classic arcade blast 'em up and features full 3D environments, all new weapons and defense systems and a 2 player split-screen mode. The gameplay, however, is exactly the same. Pilot a spacecraft and destroy the on-coming asteroids, each of different sizes. Alien ships and black holes are also out there, along with ship upgrades that update your ships weapons and defense systems.

Dragon Sword 64.name: Dragon Sword
Dragon Sword 64.summary: Dragon Sword is a third person Hack n' Slash dungeon crawler developed by Team Storm of Interactive Studios and published by MGM Interactive, whom cancelled it before release.

Namco Museum 64.name: Namco Museum 64
Namco Museum 64.summary: Namco Museum 64 is a compilation of several classic arcade games released by Namco, including Pac-Man, Ms. Pac-Man, Pole Position, Galaga, Galaxian and Dig-Dug. The game also features the ability to save high scores with the use of a Nintendo 64 Controller Pak. The N64 Rumble pack can also be used in with this game.
